claim: Nuance is a two-star Michelin restaurant in Duffel led by chef Thierry Theys.
quote: Nuance – Duffel – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant. Two MICHELIN Stars.

claim: Nuance address is Kiliaanstraat 6-8, 2570 Duffel, Belgium.
quote: Address: Kiliaanstraat 6-8, 2570 Duffel. Tel: +32 15 63 42 65 | office@resto-nuance.be

claim: Nuance officially recommends four partner hotels in Mechelen and Antwerp with stated driving times/distances, and partners with Taxi Symforosa for transport.
quote: Van der Valk Mechelen 18 min / 9.2 km; Martin's Patershof 18 min / 13.2 km; Hotel Julien 24 min / 23.6 km; Botanic Sanctuary 20 min / 22.3 km. Taxi Symforosa provides comfortable transport to and from the restaurant.

claim: Martin's Patershof occupies a restored neo-Gothic convent (built 1863) in central Mechelen, with 79 rooms inside the former monastery and church.
quote: The magnificent neo-Gothic convent was built in 1863 ... 79 beautiful rooms ... Standard rooms in the former monastery section, Executive rooms and Junior Suites in the authentic church section.

claim: Martin's Patershof preserves stained-glass windows and vaults; breakfast is served in the impressive choir of the old church.
quote: The rooms combine the exclusivity of preserved stained glass windows and vaults with the comfort of modern amenities. Breakfast in the impressive choir of the old church building.

claim: Hotel Julien occupies two renovated 16th-century townhouses in central Antwerp with 20 rooms and 1 suite, designed by Peter Ivens and Bea Mombaers.
quote: Two renovated 16th century townhouses, where subdued architecture blends design with vintage finds. 20 rooms and 1 suite. Designed by Peter Ivens & Bea Mombaers.

claim: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp is a five-star superior hotel housed across a restored 15th-century monastery complex with 108 rooms, multiple restaurants and a wellness centre.
quote: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp – luxury 5-star superior hotel set within 20,000 square meters of historic botanic gardens.

claim: Botanic Sanctuary occupies five interconnected historic buildings: a 15th-century infirmary, a 16th-century chapel, rectory and convent, the chaplain's house, and a 19th-century pharmacy.
quote: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp blends the rich histories of a 15th-century infirmary, a 16th-century chapel, rectory and convent building, along with the chaplain's house, and a 19th-century pharmacy.

claim: August occupies a former Augustinian convent in Het Groen Kwartier, Antwerp; 44 rooms designed by Belgian architect Vincent Van Duysen.
quote: Jules Bordetstraat 5, 2018 Antwerp ... 44 rooms and suites ... former Augustinian cloister transformed under the guidance of legendary Belgian architect Vincent Van Duysen in his first-ever hotel project.

claim: August comprises five interconnected buildings of the original 19th-century military hospital complex, blending spiritual character with contemporary modernism.
quote: August ... five interconnected buildings, harmoniously blending the spiritual character of the original architecture with a serene, contemporary modernism.

claim: Hof van Aragon in Lier occupies a former 16th-century girls' orphanage ('Maegdenhuys') connected to Philip the Handsome and operates as the oldest hotel in Lier (since 1963).
quote: Hof van Aragon ... the oldest and most authentic hotel in Lier ... former girls' orphanage connected to Philip the Handsome.

claim: Hof van Aragon room rates start from around €114/night with free breakfast included.
quote: You can stay at Hof Van Aragon starting at €114.10 per night ... free breakfast every morning.

claim: Sapphire House Antwerp is a 5-star Autograph Collection hotel set in a 16th-century city palace called 'Den Grooten Robijn', with 139 rooms themed by gemstone.
quote: 139 rooms & suites that blend authentic details and bespoke design ... originally called 'Den Grooten Robijn' – The Great Ruby – referring to the long heritage in gem trading.

claim: Sapphire House is inspired by Antwerp's diamond heritage and trades on 17th-century authenticity.
quote: Sapphire House Antwerp, Autograph Collection ... inspired by Antwerp's diamond heritage and showcases historic charm and 17th-century authenticity.

claim: Hotel Pure is a 7-room boutique hotel on the green edge of Lier, 5 minutes by car from the centre, with private sauna, jacuzzi and hammam.
quote: Pure ... 7 rooms designed for 2 persons ... stylish hotel with luxurious private sauna, jacuzzi and hammam, 5 minutes by car from the centre of Lier.

claim: Hotel Elisabeth is a 66-room 3-star boutique inside a beautifully renovated interwar former hospital, 5 minutes' walk from St Rumbolds Cathedral in central Mechelen.
quote: 66 stylish and contemporary designed rooms ... beautifully renovated former hospital dating from between the wars ... 5-minute walk from St Rumbolds Cathedral.

claim: Mechelen taxi tariff is €4.50 base plus €2.10 per kilometre.
quote: In Mechelen, the starting price of a taxi is 4.5 EUR, with each kilometer priced at 2.1 EUR.

claim: Lier has no reliable street-hail taxi ranks; pre-booking is required.
quote: In Lier, there are no reliable taxi ranks where you can wait for a cab without booking first, so it's crucial to book your taxi in advance.

claim: Duffel to Lier by car is roughly 8 km / about 10 minutes.
quote: Duffel to Lier ... driving distance around 8 km, about 10 minutes by car.

claim: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp rates start from around $460/night.
quote: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp from $460.

claim: August Antwerp room rates start from around €153/night.
quote: Starting at €153 per night.

claim: Botanic Sanctuary guests highlight warm service, an outstanding spa, and the calm of the gardens; criticisms focus on inconsistent service edges.
quote: Warm and attentive service, stylish and comfortable rooms ... oasis amongst the busy city ... best hotel in Antwerp by far.

claim: Hof van Aragon is the oldest hotel in Lier and the building's orphanage origin (Maegdenhuys) is its main draw.
quote: Hof van Aragon is housed in a 16th century orphanage for girls, called 'Maegdenhuys'.
